description_en: Creates a subinterface for an Express Connect circuit
kebab_example: aliyun smartag create-sag-express-connect-interface --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-whfn0000 --smart-ag-sn sag32a300000 --port-name 5 --ip 192.XX.XX.1 --mask 255.255.255.252 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSagExpressConnectInterface

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the SAG device associated with the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的智能接入网关设备序列号
parameters.name: smart_ag_sn

parameters.help_en: The name of the Express Connect port
parameters.name: port_name

parameters.help_en:
The VLAN ID of the subinterface.

Value: 0 to 4094.


If the VLAN ID is 0, this port is a physical port and does not support VLAN subinterfaces.
If the VLAN ID is 1 to 4094, this port supports VLAN subinterfaces based on the Layer 3 protocols.
You can create a maximum of 5 VLAN subinterfaces
parameters.help_zh:
专线子接口所属VLAN编码。

取值范围：0~4094。

VLAN编码为0时，代表此端口为物理端口，不使用VLAN子接口模式。
VLAN编码为1~4094时，代表此端口使用基于VLAN的三层子接口。
最多支持创建5个VLAN
parameters.name: vlan

parameters.help_en: The subnet mask of the IP address
parameters.name: mask
